scope: Static candidate tracing and application binding tests; no native negative-axis Unroll output
staticInference: The qualifying branch of a CAD selection candidate selects the largest absolute direction component (X/Y/Z tie order) and flips the direction if that component is negative before constructing a frame. The caller also checks a flag and radius against a native constant; runtime reachability, matching axis semantics between kernels, and a determinant fallback in the frame helper remain unverified.
application: Exact CAD cylinder reference binding uses the inferred sign convention without modifying the source face. Explicit numeric input and construction-cylinder sign are unchanged.

tests.red: Four of five direct exact-CAD axis cases failed before the correction; positive tie control passed.
tests.green: 141 tests across eight focused and MCP files passed, including Y/Z and three-way ties.

remaining: No native negative-axis Unroll export is available; equivalence remains unproven.
Construction-cylinder negative-Z candidate handling remains separate and unmodified.

frameThresholds.source: Digest-bound captured file-backed image; no runtime mutation established
frameThresholds.interpretation: For an exactly unit, finite direction and a nonparallel seed, the two normalized cross-product basis vectors form a right-handed orthonormal frame with determinant 1 in exact arithmetic. This does not bound floating-point errors or prove the runtime seed and direction inputs, nor establish that the fallback is unreachable.
